example_sentence: Federal funds have to be used as dictated by Washington.

definition_zh: v. 夸大, 夸张
etymology: ex(出) + ag(表加强) + ger(搬运) + ate → 全部运出 → 夸张
example_sentence: I couldn’t sleep for three days – I’m not exaggerating.

example_sentence: Slender and decently built, Roberts has the look of a martial arts expert but this is one of those movies where he has a tendency to overact.

definition_zh: v. 快而含糊地说, 吱吱喳喳地叫, 闲聊
etymology: “结巴” → 快而含糊地说
example_sentence: The tourists were jabbering away on the bus.

definition_zh: v. 狂欢作乐

example_sentence: They told him to stay home with his wife instead of going out and carousing with friends.

definition_zh: v. 狂饮, 暴食, 喝酒化掉(钱)

definition_zh: v. 拉长, (使)伸长, 延长
etymology: e + long(长的) + ate → 向外变长 → 伸长
example_sentence: Her legs were elongated by the very high heels which she wore.

definition_zh: v. 懒洋洋地说, 做作而慢慢地说
etymology: draw(抽) + l → 一点点抽出来 → 慢吞吞地说
example_sentence: ‘Can’t do that,’ he drawled languidly.

definition_zh: v. 懒洋洋地倚靠
example_sentence: He was lolling on the sofa in the shadows near the fire.

definition_zh: v. 狼吞虎咽
v. 狼吞虎咽, 大吃大喝
v. 浪费
etymology: 源自方言， 因莎士比亚在《威尼斯商人》一剧中使用而广泛流传
example_sentence: The home team squandered a number of chances in the first half.

definition_zh: v. 冷笑, 讥笑, 嘲笑
example_sentence: ‘Is that your best outfit?’ he sneered.

definition_zh: v. 离题
etymology: di(离开) + gress(走) → 走离 → 离题
example_sentence: Do you mind if I digress for a moment?

definition_zh: v. 连接
etymology: con(共同) + caten(铁链) + ate → 在同一根铁链中 → 连锁
example_sentence: For the no-arguments case, we take the sequence [0 1] and concatenate it to an expression.

definition_zh: v. 怜悯, 同情
etymology: com + miser(可怜) + ate → 同情， 怜悯
example_sentence: When I lost, he commiserated with me.

definition_zh: v. 列举
etymology: e + numer(数字) + ate → 用数字表示出来 → 列举
example_sentence: I enumerate the work that will have to be done.

etymology: im(不) + pro(在…前面) + vis(看) + e → 没有预先看过 → 即席创作
example_sentence: I forgot to bring my notes, so I had to improvise.

definition_zh: v. 留下烙印
etymology: im(不) + print(印记) → 留下印记 → 盖印
example_sentence: The company carries a variety of binders that can be imprinted with your message or logo.

definition_zh: v. 流浪, 漫游,离题
etymology: di(离开) + vag(走) + ate → 走开 → 离题； 漂泊
example_sentence: Solved the problems of the divagate teachers and the unfit teachers.

definition_zh: v. 掠夺
etymology: 来自pill(v. 抢劫)

definition_zh: v. 掠夺, 抢劫, 劫掠

definition_zh: v. 掠夺, 折磨

definition_zh: v. 滤去

definition_zh: v. 满足

definition_zh: v. 冒称

definition_zh: v. 弥补

definition_zh: v. 磨损, 摩擦, 折磨

example_sentence: My skin was abraded and very tender.

definition_zh: v. 抹掉

definition_zh: v. 目睹, 认识, 洞悉, 辨别, 看清楚

example_sentence: The blood had not coagulated.

definition_zh: v. 扭伤

definition_zh: v. 浓缩

definition_zh: v. 弄碎, 粉碎, 崩溃

definition_zh: v. 弄皱, 起皱, (使)成波状

definition_zh: v. 批判

definition_zh: v. 批准

definition_zh: v. 偏航

definition_zh: v. 平息

definition_zh: v. 迫害

definition_zh: v. 启迪

definition_zh: v. 启发

definition_zh: v. 敲诈, 逼取, 强取, 勒索

definition_zh: v. 切碎

definition_zh: v. 倾倒

definition_zh: v. 倾诉, 委托, 信赖

definition_zh: v. 清算

definition_zh: v. 求爱, 追求, 恳求, 招致

example_sentence: More than five-thousand high school students have been expelled for cheating.

definition_zh: v. 驱逐, 逐出(租户), 收回(租屋、租地等)

definition_zh: v. 屈服

definition_zh: v. 取消

definition_zh: v. 去乡下, 使定居乡下

definition_zh: v. 劝诫, 忠告

definition_zh: v. 确保

definition_zh: v. 群集

definition_zh: v. 燃烧

definition_zh: v. 染污

definition_zh: v. 认为, 相信

definition_zh: v. 融化

definition_zh: v. 蠕动

definition_zh: v. 辱骂, 斥责

example_sentence: The President was now reviled by the same party he had helped to lead.

definition_zh: v. 烧焦, 枯萎

example_sentence: The spider must wait for prey to be ensnared on its web.

example_sentence: He tries to counterfeit all the good things God offers you, aiming at our weakness in order to exploit our vulnerabilities and entice us into the darkness.

example_sentence: The wall through Berlin was finally ruptured, prefiguring the reunification of Germany.
